# Infinity Edge

Infinity Edge is a legendary item in League of Legends.

## Overview

- **Tier:** 2
- **Type:** Legendary
- **Cost:** Total: 3500 • Combine: 725
- **Modes:** Arena, Howling Abyss, Nexus Blitz, Summoner's Rift

## Background

Only the boldest of men and women dare take the risky trip to the hottest spot in [Valoran](./Valoran.md), in the very center of the [Shurima](./Shurima.md) Desert. Those who successfully make the journey may bathe their swords in a magical pool of the purest water known to this world. Any edge dipped into this pool will stay sharper and strike truer than any other sword.

## Notes

- The critical strike damage stat provided by **Infinity Edge** increases most champions' total critical strike damage from 200% AD to 230% AD.

## Trivia

- **Infinity Edge** shares its name with a set of Infinity Weapons from the game _[Lineage II](./Wikipedia:Lineage_II.md),_ which are the strongest weapons available. **Infinity Edge** bears similarities to the [Infinity Shaper](https://l2vn.com/upload/images/InfinityShaper.png).
- As hinted in its lore, the Infinity Edge got its powers from the _Oasis of the Dawn_ located in the Ancient [Shuriman](./Shurima.md) Capital, the once center of the vast Shuriman Empire. The Oasis is described as a pool with many magical properties.
- Infinity Edge was in the old [Summoner's Rift](./Summoner's_Rift.md) map, specifically in the [shopkeeper](./shop.md)'s bag.
  - It is still hung on display in both shops.
- **Infinity Edge** looks somewhat similar to Kayle's old sword in terms of blade shape and inscriptions.
- Pentakill's second volume, [Pentakill II: Grasp of the Undying](./Pentakill_II:_Grasp_of_the_Undying.md), named its fourth track after this item.
- This item was featured in [The Call](./The_Call.md) and [Katarina: Issue 4](./Katarina:_Issue_4.md).
